audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose describes a generic 'range war' and the level chart disagrees between layers on three rows.
audit.why: The lane is decided by one conditional stun: Scatter the Weak (E, 15s, 650) only stuns through a Dark Sphere. That, not raw range, is what makes levels 1-5 hers.
audit.corrected: Early difficulty tied to sphere placement and the 15s E; post-6 flipped to Anivia to match the packet chart and the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never mention Unleashed Power's execute or the 120/100/80s cooldown.
audit.why: Syndra's R (675 range) executes low-health targets — against Anivia that means the egg can be killed a second time on the same commit.
audit.corrected: Level 6 / behind advice keyed to the R execute threshold and its 675 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly calls Force of Will (W) the stun; it is not. Wall is also described as blocking 'dash-adjacent E repositioning' — Scatter the Weak is a knockback, not a dash.
audit.why: Force of Will (W, 12/11/10/9/8s, 925) throws a sphere or minion for damage and a slow, upgraded to bonus TRUE damage by Transcendent. The stun is Scatter the Weak (E), and only when it pushes a Dark Sphere through you.
audit.corrected: Stun attributed to Scatter the Weak with the sphere condition stated; W described as true-damage poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advises no answer to Syndra's damage type.
audit.why: Transcendent grants Force of Will bonus true damage and Unleashed Power executes, so stacking MR is partly wasted gold here (flagged in missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: Health over pure MR called out in the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].side said Syndra while win[4..6] and packet.levelChart said Anivia.
audit.why: Three of seven rows rendered two different answers to the same question.
audit.corrected: Full layer aligned to the content layer and the packet chart.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. It governs your forward steps. - W Crystallize spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak (E) is 15s and only stuns when it pushes a Dark Sphere through you — no sphere near you, no stun. - Dark Sphere is 7s, so she cannot cover every angle. - Crystallize spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Unleashed Power executes below a threshold.

edits.before: Syndra wins by landing Scatter the Weak (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Syndra wins by parking a Dark Sphere on you, stunning through it with Scatter the Weak, and executing the egg with Unleashed Power.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Syndra burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Step up only when no Dark Sphere is sitting beside you: Flash Frost for the chill, E for double damage, and leave before her 7s Q comes back.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Syndra walks straight at you.
edits.after: Last-hitting next to a live Dark Sphere — that sphere is Scatter the Weak's stun, and the whole combo follows it.

edits.before: Good trade: Threaten Q until Syndra burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade. Bad trade: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Syndra walks straight at you.
edits.after: Good trade: Step up only when no Dark Sphere is sitting beside you: Flash Frost for the chill, E for double damage, and leave before her 7s Q comes back. Bad trade: Last-hitting next to a live Dark Sphere — that sphere is Scatter the Weak's stun, and the whole combo follows it.

edits.before: If Syndra opens the score, reset expectations and respect Scatter the Weak (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with R wave-clear and stay relevant through zone control.
edits.after: If Syndra opens the score, the Unleashed Power threshold now covers your whole bar, egg included. Stop crossing the 675 range line — farm with R from behind the wave and win it back on zone control.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by taking her ground: the stun needs a sphere on you, and storm plus wall stop her ever standing where she can place one.

edits.before: The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Flash Frost outranges Dark Sphere, 1075 to 800 — threaten from the edge and she must walk forward to answer, which is your stun window.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Syndra burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Glacial Storm clears the wave instantly, so her sphere-by-sphere shove stops buying tempo and the roam timer becomes yours instead.

edits.before: Syndra whiffs Scatter the Weak (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Scatter the Weak is 15s — whiffed, she has no way to stop the gank.

edits.before: Your wall is your Flash — a wasted Crystallize means the next gank kills the bird AND the egg.
edits.after: Force of Will throws the sphere from 925 range for true damage — resistances do not pay for that last-hit.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Syndra walks straight at you.
edits.after: Unleashed Power is 675 range and executes — below that threshold the egg is not a second life, it is a second kill.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Lost Chapter rush into Rod of Ages or Seraph's; then Archangel's, Rabadon's, Zhonya's vs dive. Mana is your real first item.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Lost Chapter into Rod of Ages or Seraph's, then Archangel's, Rabadon's, Zhonya's. Force of Will deals true damage — buy health, not raw MR.

edits.before: Same story at level 4 — her poke range and stun combo continue to outvalue your trades.
edits.after: Level 3 gives her Scatter the Weak — any sphere left beside you is now a full stun.

edits.before: Hold Wall to block her dash-adjacent E repositioning or to punish overextension
edits.after: Hold Wall to cut the knockback line of Scatter the Weak or punish her overextension

edits.before: Bait Force of Will before committing Flash Frost so she can't stun-lock your combo
edits.after: Bait Scatter the Weak (15s) before committing Flash Frost — her stun needs a sphere

edits.before: Anivia's teamfight zoning with Wall splitting the fight out-values Syndra's single-target burst combo, provided you aren't caught out by her Force of Will stun on unaware positioning.
edits.after: Anivia's teamfight zoning with Wall splitting the fight out-values Syndra's single-target burst combo, provided you aren't caught by Scatter the Weak knocking a sphere through you at 650 range.

edits.before: Level 6 flips the range advantage: Glacial Storm covers more area than her stun-combo threat radius, letting you punish her for overextending to land spheres. Use Storm to zone her off the wave and force disengages, and look for all-in windows the moment she's used her stun combo offensively and missed. She still has burst if she catches you out of position with Force of Will, so respect her engage range even while ahead.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the range advantage: Glacial Storm covers more area than her stun-combo threat radius, letting you punish her for overextending to land spheres. Use Storm to zone her off the wave and force disengages, and look for all-in windows the moment she misses Scatter the Weak — that is 15 seconds with no stun. She still bursts you if a sphere sits beside you, so clear that ground before you step up.

edits.before: With core items, Anivia's area control and kiting answer Syndra's poke reliably, and Wall lets you split a teamfight or block her stun setup before she reaches your backline. Position carefully around Force of Will since a single catch can flip a fight in her favor even late, but overall your Storm-Frostbite combo and superior zone control win extended skirmishes against her single-target burst kit.
edits.after: With core items, Anivia's area control and kiting answer Syndra's poke reliably, and Wall lets you split a teamfight or cut her 650-range knockback line before she reaches your backline. Watch for a sphere landing next to you, since one Scatter the Weak stun still flips a fight late, but overall your Storm-Frostbite combo and superior zone control win extended skirmishes against her burst kit.

notes: Force of Will (W) was called the stun in four separate places; the stun is Scatter the Weak (E) and only through a Dark Sphere. Wall was also described as blocking a 'dash' — Syndra has no dash. Level chart: content win[] already matched packet.levelChart, only the full layer's last three rows disagreed, so those edits fix an existing disagreement rather than create one. Ratings left untouched despite the side flips — rating semantics were not clear enough to change safely. Text throughout uses 'his' for Syndra; not corrected where the sentence was otherwise sound and untouched.
